cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
import planfuzz, planning, networkx as nx
from networkx.algorithms.flow import maximum_flow, max_flow_min_cost, shortest_augmenting_path
rng=random.Random(1017)
ctx, active = planfuzz.make_case(rng, 5, 3, 2)
pairs = planning._reachable_pairs(ctx, active)
G = nx.DiGraph()
for key in ctx['request_paths']:
    cap=ctx['request_quotas'][key]['capacity']; parent=ctx['request_quotas'][key]['parent']
    G.add_edge('source' if parent is None else 'rq:'+parent, 'rq:'+key, capacity=cap, weight=0)
for key in ctx['offer_paths']:
    cap=ctx['offer_quotas'][key]['capacity']; parent=ctx['offer_quotas'][key]['parent']
    G.add_edge('oq:'+key, 'sink' if parent is None else 'oq:'+parent, capacity=cap, weight=0)
used_r=set(); used_o=set()
for oid, rows in pairs.items():
    for rid,_ in rows: used_r.add(rid); used_o.add(oid)
for r in used_r: G.add_edge('rq:'+ctx['requests'][r]['group'], 'r:'+r, capacity=1, weight=0)
for o in used_o: G.add_edge('o:'+o, 'oq:'+ctx['offers'][o]['group'], capacity=ctx['offers'][o]['capacity'], weight=ctx['offers'][o]['cost'])
for o, rows in pairs.items():
    for r,_ in rows: G.add_edge('r:'+r, 'o:'+o, capacity=1, weight=0)
print('maxflow', maximum_flow(G,'source','sink', flow_func=shortest_augmenting_path.ShortestAugmentingPath, value_only=True))
f = max_flow_min_cost(G,'source','sink')
print('mfmc value', sum(f['source'].values()))
print('cost', sum(d.get('flow',0)*d.get('weight',0) for u,v,d in G.edges(data=True)))
print('edge flows', [(u,v,d['flow']) for u,v,d in G.edges(data=True) if d.get('flow')])
"
